Stationary points occur where the derivative f'(x) = 0. First, differentiate y = f(x) to get f'(x). Then solve f'(x) = 0 for x. Plug each x back into f(x) to find the y-values. These points are where the function stops increasing or decreasing. It’s a concept I understand from physics, not from math classes.
